textbookText: 11. A part of periodic table is given below. Study it and answer the following questions.
i) How are these elements arranged?
Li Be B C N O F Ne
Ans:- The elements are arranged in the increasing order of their atomic number from Na Mg Al Si P S Cl Ar
left to right in each period of the modern periodic table.
ii) Which one is more active in between Li and Na, and why?
Ans:- Between Lithium (Li) and Sodium (Na), sodium (Na) is more active. This is because sodium lies below lithium in the
same group, has a larger atomic size, and loses its valence electron more easily.
